description: This file defines a Java class 'AvroDateTimeMapper' that provides methods to convert Java date/time objects (OffsetDateTime, LocalDateTime, LocalDate) into their ISO-8601 string representations, used for serialization in event processing within the Fineract project.

classes.name: AvroDateTimeMapper
classes.description: Provides methods to serialize Java date/time objects into ISO-8601 string format for event serialization.

methods.name: mapOffsetDateTime
methods.description: Converts an OffsetDateTime object to an ISO-8601 formatted string, or returns null if input is null.

methods.name: mapLocalDateTime
methods.description: Converts a LocalDateTime object to an ISO-8601 formatted string, or returns null if input is null.

methods.name: mapLocalDate
methods.description: Converts a LocalDate object to an ISO-8601 formatted string, or returns null if input is null.
